title: Air Force captain Oliveira at the national war college

tellings.quote: in 1954 actually in the Escola superior degera you know basically the national war college here there was an air force captain Olivivera and he said this phenomena is real

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels, in an episode on Brazil's UFO cases, says that in 1954 an Air Force captain named Oliveira spoke at the Escola Superior de Guerra, Brazil's national war college. According to Michels, the captain told them that the UFO phenomenon is real. It matters because, if true, it would mean a military officer said so openly inside one of Brazil's top military schools decades ago.
